description:
Session GenServer that owns a per-run conversation state. This
ticket wires the public API — prompt/continue/steer/follow_up/abort/
subscribe/state/wait_for_idle — but all they do at this point is
manage state transitions + enqueue. No LLM stream, no tool dispatch
yet; those land in z1d.3.

OctoPi.Agent.start_session(opts) :: {:ok, pid}
OctoPi.Agent.prompt(pid, msg | msgs)
OctoPi.Agent.continue(pid)
OctoPi.Agent.steer(pid, msg)
OctoPi.Agent.follow_up(pid, msg)
OctoPi.Agent.abort(pid)
OctoPi.Agent.subscribe(pid, listener_pid, mode :: :sync | :async) :: {:ok, unsubscribe_fn}
OctoPi.Agent.state(pid) :: state_view()
OctoPi.Agent.wait_for_idle(pid, timeout \\\\ 30_000) :: :ok | :timeout

State transitions to get right now:
- Idle → Running (on prompt/continue)
- Running → Idle (when loop task exits; we'll stub that here)
- Running → Aborting → Idle (on abort)

TDD:
- Subscribe returns unsubscribe closure; calling it removes listener.
- Two listeners of same mode preserve registration order.
- state/1 returns a struct snapshot (no live refs).
- abort/1 on an idle session is a no-op.
- steer/1 enqueues into the Session state.

Depends on z1d.1.
title: Session GenServer: state + public API signatures (no loop yet)
